message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openthread && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/ncp_uart_received.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":31,"var":"data,size","code":"memcpy(buf, data, size); otPlatUartReceived(buf, (uint16_t)size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes from the fuzz input are copied into a UART receive buffer and injected into the NCP UART path.","depends_on":[]},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/core/thread/address_resolver.cpp","function":"HandleAddressQuery","line":584,"var":"aMessage","code":"Parse incoming CoAP address-query message and extract ThreadTargetTlv.","note":"The UART-fed frame is processed into a CoAP address query, and the target EID becomes attacker-controlled protocol input.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"UART frame contents"}]},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/core/thread/address_resolver.cpp","function":"HandleAddressQuery","line":605,"var":"targetTlv.GetTarget()","code":"SendAddressQueryResponse(targetTlv, mlIidTlv, NULL, aMessageInfo.GetPeerAddr());","note":"If the target is a unicast address owned by the node, the resolver builds an address-notification response using the attacker-supplied target TLV.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"parsed target address"}]},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/core/thread/address_resolver.cpp","function":"SendAddressQueryResponse","line":631,"var":"aTargetTlv / aMlEidTlv / aDestination","code":"Construct CoAP POST to OT_URI_PATH_ADDRESS_NOTIFY and append target, mesh-local EID, and RLOC16 TLVs.","note":"The response payload is assembled from the propagated target and local addressing state, creating the exact message that will be transmitted.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"data","via":"response construction"}]},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/core/thread/address_resolver.cpp","function":"SendAddressQueryResponse","line":650,"var":"message","code":"SuccessOrExit(error = Get<Coap::Coap>().SendMessage(*message, messageInfo));","note":"The crafted CoAP message is handed to the transport stack for transmission.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"data","via":"serialized CoAP payload"}]},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/core/thread/mesh_forwarder_ftd.cpp","function":"PrepareIndirectFrame","line":854,"var":"Get<AddressResolver>().Resolve(ip6Header.GetDestination(), mMeshDest)","code":"Resolve on-mesh destination through AddressResolver when forwarding IPv6 traffic.","note":"The vulnerable sink is reached when forwarding logic consults AddressResolver for an on-mesh destination, leading to the stack-buffer-overflow read in ot::Message::Write during response generation.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"control","via":"network-triggered forwarding path"},{"on":3,"type":"data","via":"same target EID path"}]}
]
p.write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
PY
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openthread/tests/fuzz/ncp_uart_received.cpp /workspace/candidate_trace.json
